blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — More than 500 houses could be affected by the city’s effort to reclaim the legally required three-meter easements along eight rivers and waterways. The local government continues to identify structures that obstruct water flow and block access for flood-control operations to determine the exact scope of the clearing. Kenneth Siasar, chief of staff to Mayor Nestor Archival, disclosed the preliminary estimate during the mayor’s regular press conference on Monday, Nov. 16, saying the city’s River Troopers were still consolidating data from barangays to determine the extent of the encroachments.
